musicConsent.title: Signing in to Yandex Music
musicConsent.intro: Full playback through Yandex Music requires signing in with Yandex ID.
musicConsent.credentials: You enter your password and verification codes yourself on the Yandex page in the embedded browser. Check the sign-in page address before entering them.
musicConsent.privacyCode: SonaRelay code does not read password or verification-code fields or record keystrokes.
musicConsent.privacySending: SonaRelay code does not send these credentials to its own servers or Last.fm. The browser and Yandex website handle sign-in.
musicConsent.privacyUse: SonaRelay reads information about the music being played for display and, if you connect Last.fm, scrobbling.
musicConsent.session: Chromium saves cookies and technical session data locally to keep you signed in. This does not mean that no authentication data is stored.
musicConsent.storageAccess: Data is stored in the application profile at the path below. Windows permissions control access; software running as you and administrators may have access. Protection from other software cannot be guaranteed.
musicConsent.source: SonaRelay source code is publicly available under Apache License 2.0 for independent review. Source availability does not guarantee security.
musicConsent.recommendation: If you prefer not to use your main account, create a separate Yandex ID for listening to music.
musicConsent.unofficial: SonaRelay is an unofficial application and is not affiliated with Yandex.
musicConsent.responsibility: You sign in voluntarily and choose which account to use. Keep your credentials safe and check the pages where you enter them.
musicConsent.acknowledgement: By selecting Continue, you acknowledge this information and make your own decision about signing in.
musicConsent.saveError: Your acknowledgment could not be saved. The source was not changed. Please try again.

musicConsent.required: Review the notice before opening Yandex Music.
